checks.name: identical fact saves serialize to one identity and receipt, preserving global input
conflicting simultaneous fact request rejects changed sharing intent
variant source edit first rejects stale confirmation even with a fresh record version
fact save first preserves original provenance across a subsequent variant edit
withdrawal wins against stale reconfirmation and old save retry never reactivates the fact
reconfirmation wins and a delayed withdrawal cannot revoke the newer fact revision
erasure fences blocked fact saves and reads, then cascades all fact history
fact save completes before erasure and cannot survive its later cascade
legacy global writes serialize with fact saves and cannot discard independent facts
